rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Under Article 83(a), Decree No. 300 appoints Fradkov Mikhail Efimovich Chairman of the Government; point 2 puts the decree into force on the day of its signature; signed 'Президент Российской Федерации В.Путин', Moscow, Kremlin, 5 March 2004, No. 300.
